compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
The single-pass review system was a demo the project has been retiring; the real reviews are the four-phase plan review and four-phase code review, whose single-turn criteria are steps inside those workflows (operator ruling 2026-09-06). `src/rebar/llm/operations.py:135-201 _review_ticket_impl` (plus `_REVIEW_MIN_STEPS:42`, `default_reviewer_id:45-55`, docstring `:1-17`) survives only for two callers: `src/rebar/llm/review_workflows.py:86 diff_review_paths` (the WS-K2 parallel-run-and-diff; sole importer `tests/interfaces/store/test_review_as_workflow.py:16`) and `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_solver.py:406-414` (the `ticket-quality` branch). `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/ticket_quality.md` is the prompt behind `reviewers/index.json:80-92` (`default: true`, langfuse `rebar-ticket-quality`), the eval spec `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/ticket-quality.eval.yaml`, and `src/rebar/llm/workflow/examples/review_skeleton.yaml:39`. It is the catalog's ONLY `default: true` reviewer; `src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompts.py:290-293` raises on zero defaults and `select_reviewers` (`prompts.py:620-633`, public via `rebar.llm.__init__.py:60`, `tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json:2321`) unions every default, so a replacement default is required. `docs/release-notes.md:513` and `src/rebar/_deprecations.py:109-111` record the previous decision to keep the engine. `src/rebar/llm/aggregate.py` (125 LOC) is the ADR-0075-orphaned multi-reviewer aggregator: `aggregate_findings` has no src caller (ADR 0108 `:123-129`) but `src/rebar/llm/spec_scan.py:13,137` imports `_severity_rank`. Proof the four-phase workflows are untouched: `git grep -n "ticket-quality\|ticket_quality" origin/main -- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json src/rebar/llm/code_review/ src/rebar/llm/criteria/ 'src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_*.md' 'src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-*.md' .rebar/criteria_routing.json` returns zero hits, and `workflow/gates/*.yaml` prompt ids are all `code-review-*` or gate prompts (`code-review.yaml:105-148`). Cites are on origin/main 2e81cb9767c1.

## Approach
1. `operations.py`: delete docstring paragraphs 1-2 of `:1-17` (rewrite as "shared deterministic context builder for the gates plus the `select_reviewers` re-export"), `:38-42`, `:45-55`, `:135-201`; `__all__` at `:33` becomes `["assemble_context", "select_reviewers"]`; keep the `TYPE_CHECKING` import of `PrefetchSpec`; drop the now-unused `replace`, `LLMError`, `Runner`, `RunRequest`, `get_runner`, `resolve_gate_config` imports.
2. `git rm src/rebar/llm/review_workflows.py src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/ticket-quality.eval.yaml src/rebar/llm/reviewers/ticket_quality.md`.
3. `eval_solver.py:406-414` delete the branch; drop the `operations` import if unused.
4. `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code_quality.md` front-matter: add `default: true` (it is the code-review rules layer's natural always-on reviewer; today `applies_to: []` means it is never selected). Run `python -m rebar.llm.prompting.prompts regenerate-index` (the CI drift gate, `docs/llm-framework.md:395-397`): `ticket-quality` leaves `index.json` and `code-quality` carries `"default": true`.
5. `review_skeleton.yaml:39` becomes `- prompt: spec-alignment`, because it is the only surviving `category: review` prompt whose subject is ticket or plan text (the skeleton's input is `plan`) and it is not already used in the skeleton (`code-quality` is the batch finder at `:37`, `completion-verifier` the verifier at `:51`), so the sample keeps its shape of two always-on criteria plus one `when`-gated. Mirror at `docs/workflow-engine.md:103` and the `:10` comment in the yaml.
6. `aggregate.py`: move `_SEVERITY_RANK` and `_severity_rank` (`:19-24`) into `spec_scan.py` as private module helpers replacing the import at `:13` (the only edit to `spec_scan.py`); `git rm src/rebar/llm/aggregate.py`; delete `src/rebar/llm/__init__.py:36` and `:107`; fix comments `src/rebar/llm/code_review/workflow_ops.py:24,150` ("mirrors aggregate.py" becomes "10-line bucket"); `docs/llm-framework.md:662` stays as history.
7. Docs: `docs/llm-framework.md:352` sample `"reviewers": ["ticket-quality"]` becomes `["spec-alignment"]`; `docs/reuse-surface.md:313` example id becomes `code-quality`; ADRs untouched.
8. `docs/release-notes.md` new entry: "BREAKING (pre-1.0): the single-pass review engine and `rebar.llm.aggregate_findings` are removed. `rebar.llm.operations._review_ticket_impl` (private), the packaged `ticket-quality` reviewer prompt (Langfuse name `rebar-ticket-quality`) and its eval spec, and the public `rebar.llm.aggregate_findings` export are gone; `code-quality` is now the catalog's default reviewer, so `rebar.llm.select_reviewers([])` returns `["code-quality"]`. Use `rebar.llm.review_plan`." (`rebar.llm` is the "less settled" row, `docs/api-stability.md:28`.)

## Scope
The files above. Out of scope: `assemble_context` (`gate_ops.py:191` consumer), `completion.py`, `spec_scan.py` beyond the 3-line helper move, `provider_parity.py:88` (the eval-harness epic replaces `frozenset({"completion-verifier", "ticket-quality", "spec-alignment"})` with `frozenset({"completion-verifier", "spec-alignment"})`; harmless until run, no dependency).

## Testing
One test file is deleted (`tests/interfaces/contracts/test_review_budget.py`), one is renamed (`test_review_as_workflow.py` to `test_runner_agent_step_bridge.py`), eleven tests are rewritten against `spec_scan.scan_epics_for_spec` (the structural sibling with the same `gate_source` threading and `runner=` seam), the `ticket-quality` id is swapped to `code-quality` in nine stand-in uses, and three golden sets drop the id. The exact list is in this ticket's first comment. Happy path: `select_reviewers([])` returns `['code-quality']` and the skeleton workflow validates. Edge: the regenerate-index drift gate is clean and the catalog has exactly one default.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `git grep -n "_review_ticket_impl\|review_workflows\|ticket-quality\|ticket_quality\|rebar-ticket-quality\|aggregate_findings" -- src tests docs scripts ':!docs/release-notes.md' ':!docs/adr' ':!docs/experiments' ':!tests/fixtures'` prints nothing.
- [ ] `python -m rebar.llm.prompting.prompts regenerate-index && git diff --exit-code src/rebar/llm/reviewers/index.json` is clean and `index.json` has exactly one `"default": true` (`code-quality`), asserted by `tests/unit/test_prompt_index.py::test_index_has_exactly_one_default`.
- [ ] `python -c "import rebar.llm as l; print(l.select_reviewers([]))"` prints `['code-quality']`.
- [ ] `rebar workflow validate src/rebar/llm/workflow/examples/review_skeleton.yaml` is clean and `tests/unit/workflow/test_review_skeleton.py` is green.
- [ ] The workflow-untouched grep (context section) still prints zero hits.
- [ ] `python scripts/gen_api_surface.py --check` is clean; `make verify` exits 0.
